category.reason: The task requires comparing the visible post counts across tags and identifying the smallest value.

instruction.en: Find the name of the tag with the fewest posts among tags whose post counts are visible.
instruction.zh: 在帖子数量可见的标签中，找到帖子数量最少的标签名称。

reference.patch: Restricted the instruction to tags with visible post counts because a partially visible tag has no readable post count; updated the category reason accordingly.
